description: This Dart source file defines an API client class for interacting with a bookstore backend. It includes methods to fetch books and transaction records from a REST API, using environment variables for configuration, and fetches data via HTTP requests.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A simple REST API client for the bookstore backend, providing methods to fetch books and transactions from the backend service.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Reads the backend base URL from environment variables; returns null if not configured or empty.

methods.name: fetchBooks
methods.description: Fetches a list of books from the backend API endpoint, throws if the base URL is missing or request fails.

methods.name: fetchTransactions
methods.description: Fetches a list of transaction records from the backend API endpoint, throws if the base URL is missing or request fails.
